efile.text: You must file and pay electronically if: you submit 10 or more W-2 and/or 1099 forms with Form WHT-434, Annual Withholding Reconciliation, or you pay withholding tax on the semi-weekly schedule or a payroll filing service is used or your total withholding remitted for the prior calendar year exceeded $100,000.

returns.name: Form WHT-434, Annual Withholding Reconciliation
contents: Every taxpayer (semiweekly, monthly and quarterly) files it, due the last day of January; it is the transmittal for the W-2 and 1099 forms and reconciles the year's withholding to them.

Electronic filing is required for 10 or more W-2/1099 forms, semiweekly payers, anyone using a payroll filing service, and prior-year remittances over $100,000 (written exemption requests go to the Director of Taxpayer Services).

notModelled: Vermont's MONTHLY and QUARTERLY payment dates: the page states the monthly 25th/February 23 rule but no due date for Form WHT-436, so the third monthly payment and the quarterly payment are not computed.

deposits.interpretation: Vermont's payment frequency 'will mirror your federal payment frequency': a federal semi-weekly depositor pays Vermont semi-weekly. SEMIWEEKLY (modelled): tax withheld for pay dates on Wednesday, Thursday or Friday is due the following Wednesday; for all other pay dates the following Friday. The page also describes a MONTHLY schedule (by the 25th of the following month; January's payment is due the 23rd of February, extended to the following Monday if the 23rd is a weekend; the first and second months are paid by their due dates and the third with the quarterly reconciliation) and a QUARTERLY schedule (paid with Form WHT-436), but it states no due date for Form WHT-436, so the third-month and quarterly payment dates cannot be computed. Those two frequencies are therefore NOT MODELLED here: supplying 'monthly' or 'quarterly' returns an error rather than a guess. The frequency is an INPUT (it follows the federal schedule).

channels.description: myVTax (free online filing and payment); the Department lists filing specifications for WHT-434, 1099 and EFW-2 (W-2) submissions; a payroll filing service makes electronic filing mandatory for its client
enrollment: Register for a Vermont withholding account (steps not read) and use myVTax; employers who use a payroll filing service must file and pay electronically.

The Department publishes 'myVTax Guide: How to Submit W-2s, 1099s, and WHT-434', 'Vermont 1099 Information E-filing Specifications', 'Vermont Electronic W-2 (EFW-2) Filing Specifications' and 'Vermont WHT-434 Filing Specifications' (2025 revisions) on its withholding page; none was read.
